newsitem.title: USA: Yellow Corp sees Q2 EPS above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Yellow Corp sees Q2 EPS above estimates.

text.p: Yellow Corp said Thursday that based on April and May results, it expects second quarter earnings to exceed analysts' consensus estimate of $0.25 a share.
Yellow cited continuing cost reduction and productivity improvements, better-than-planned tonnage growth at its Yellow Freight subsidiary, and a stabilizing pricing environment.
April and May revenue per day at Yellow Freight grew by more than 11 percent over the same months of 1996.
Yellow Corp, a less-than-truckload transportation company, earned $0.07 a share in the second quarter last year.
